status: fixed before any held-out scene evaluation
purpose: A small calibrated real-lighting stereo pilot, complementary to monocular research; not a full DTU benchmark or a novelty claim
dataset: Original DTU MVS SampleSet; original STL points and supplied right-image projection matrices
source_views: the other two selected views, equally weighted
matched_condition: reference and all sources use most diffuse light3
mismatched_conditions: reference stays at light3; all sources use one fixed alternative real lighting state
image_resize: OpenCV INTER_AREA, explicit pixel-center camera resize transform
pixel_origin_note: supplied projection convention, to be checked on development scene only before evaluation; no fitted scale
depth_sampling: uniform camera-Z in mm; broad range fixed from acquisition geometry, verified on development scene only
color_space: inverse-sRGB approximation to linear RGB; provided images are processed RGB, not calibrated RAW
numerical_precision: float64 photometric moments and correlation; float32 stored winner costs and depth maps
gain_prior: reference/source global mean channel ratio (diagonal) or pooled mean ratio (scalar), from input images only
gain_model: positive regularized gain only; no offsets. Gains optimized within each depth-hypothesis matching cost
gain_novelty: classical radiometric-nuisance optimization; no new color-constancy method claimed
postprocessing: none; winner-takes-all on identical depth candidates and geometric patch support
reference_depth: z-buffer of original structured-light point samples, no interpolation or fitted geometry
evaluation_mask: valid projected STL reference samples, shared source visibility, common geometric inference support; identical for every lighting and method
gt_usage: only geometry checks, development calibration and evaluation; never photometric cost, gain prior or inference initialization
statistics: report each held-out view and descriptive mean; one held-out scene, no population confidence intervals
claim_boundary: DTU lights vary direction; this demonstrates lighting/radiometric effects. Without ground-truth illuminant chromaticity it does not establish absolute color constancy
ground_plane_mask: Original supplied Plane{scene}.mat, homogeneous plane value>0, evaluation only
